                        FINANCE COMMITTEE
                            APRIL 4, 2019

                                    MINUTES
NON-PUBLIC MEETING

     The City of Clarksville Finance Committee met in a non-public meeting with City
     Attorney Lance Baker on Thursday, April 4, 2019, at 6:15 p.m. in City Council
     Chambers, 106 Public Square, Clarksville, Tennessee. All members were present along
     with Mayor Joe Pitts. Discussions were held regarding the Doe claim and the
     Roe v. City case.

PUBLIC MEETING CALL TO ORDER

     The public meeting was called to order 6:46 p.m. by Chairman Jeff Burkhart.

ATTENDANCE

     PRESENT:      Jeff Burkhart, Tim Chandler, Valerie Guzman, Jeff Henley, Stacey
     Streetman

CONSIDERATION OF CLAIM

     Councilwoman Guzman made a motion to reject the claim made by Pat Doe as
     recommended by the City Attorney. The motion was seconded by Councilman Henley.
     A voice vote was taken; the motion passed without objection.

CONSIDERATION OF SETTLEMENT DEMAND

     Councilman Chandler made a motion to reject the settlement demand of $650,000 made
     by Lee Roe, et al. The motion was seconded by Councilman Henley. A voice vote
     was taken; the motion passed without objection.
    Councilman Burkhart made a motion to authorize the City Attorney to make a counter
    offer as discussed during the non-public meeting. The motion was seconded by
    Councillady Streetman. A voice vote was taken; Councilman Henley voted “nay.” The
    motion passed.

ADJOURNMENT

    The meeting was adjourned at 6:48 p.m.
